title: VaryST: Generalizable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Beyond the Closed-World Setting
abstract: arXiv:2610.19813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting is fundamental to many real-world systems, yet deployment environments are inherently varying: temporal distributions may evolve, spatial domains may change, and observation availability may shift from training conditions. Existing models are often tightly coupled to their training environments through node-specific representations, predefined spatial support sets, and reliance on consistently available observations, limiting generalization to changing environments. To this end, we propose VaryST, a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations. To accommodate temporal changes, VaryST derives node representations from long-term histories, capturing current behavior in the context of longer-term patterns. translated_title: VaryST：超越封闭世界设定的可泛化时空预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19813v1 公告类型：新 摘要：时空预测对许多现实世界系统至关重要，然而部署环境本质上是多变的：时间分布可能演变，空间域可能发生变化，观测数据的可用性也可能偏离训练时的条件。现有模型往往通过节点特定表示、预定义的空间支持集以及对持续可用观测数据的依赖，与训练环境紧密耦合，这限制了对变化环境的泛化能力。为此，我们提出了 VaryST，一个从头训练的紧凑型时空预测模型，它通过从可用的长期观测中动态构建预测上下文，实现了强大的泛化能力。为了适应时间变化，VaryST 从长期历史中推导节点表示，在更长期模式的背景下捕捉当前行为。为了适应空间变化，它动态选择功能相关的（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了从零训练的紧凑时空预测模型 VaryST，通过从可用的长期观测中动态构建预测上下文，实现了在时间分布演变、空间域变化和观测可用性变化等开放环境下的强泛化预测能力。
en_tdlr: VaryST is a compact spatio-temporal forecasting model trained from scratch that achieves strong generalization beyond closed-world settings by dynamically constructing predictive context from available long-term observations, adapting to evolving temporal distributions, changing spatial domains, and shifting observation availability.
